answer:
Richard Nixon, the person who delivered the famous "Checkers Speech" on September 23, 1952, died on **April 22, 1994**. 

He passed away at his home in New York City following a debilitating stroke he suffered four days earlier. At the time of his death, he was 81 years old. His funeral was held later that week in Yorba Linda, California, where he was also born.
